description: A shell script that defines a set of Git repository tests focusing on rev-list path optimization. It contains test descriptions, setup commands for a Git repository, and test cases that verify the behavior of Git rev-list with different pathspecs and commit dependencies.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution, with setup steps provided.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the mock time or environment to simulate passage of time between Git operations.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual outputs for test results.
